dream-num/univer.zh: 使用 Univer Office SDK 打造你自己的 AI 辦公室。將編輯、計算、協作與檔案處理整合進你的產品，供人員與 AI Agent 使用。基於可擴充的開源核心建構。

elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter.source: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 82 skills, 15 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
elementalsouls/Claude-BugHunter.zh: 用於漏洞挖掘與外部紅隊作業的 Claude Code 技能套件：82 項技能、15 個斜線指令，收錄 24 種核心漏洞類別中精選的 681 種已公開揭露報告模式，並附企業身分與基礎設施攻擊矩陣。

elripalda/RecompLauncher.source: PC recomps, all in one place. Find, install, update and play PC recomps from one launcher.
elripalda/RecompLauncher.zh: PC recomps 一站式整合。從單一啟動器尋找、安裝、更新並遊玩 PC recomps。

elvarofficial/teardown.source: A Claude Code skill that turns any machine into a 3D simulator you can take apart
elvarofficial/teardown.zh: 一款 Claude Code 技能，可將任何機器變成可拆解的 3D 模擬器。

enesozturk/dimensional-drawing.source: Create Apple style dimensional drawings of UI components.
enesozturk/dimensional-drawing.zh: 建立 Apple 風格的 UI 元件尺寸標註圖。

erkamyaman/rust-anything.source: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
erkamyaman/rust-anything.zh: 將整個應用程式以 Rust 重寫，一次一個部分，並在每個步驟對照原始程式所記錄的行為進行驗證。支援以 TypeScript、Python、C、Go、Ruby 與 Java 撰寫的 CLI、HTTP 伺服器與函式庫。

ersinkoc/phonebox.source: Turn an old Android phone into a customizable desk panel and touch control deck for Windows, Linux and macOS. 124 widgets and 30 templates for system stats, AI coding, media and automation, in 13 languages. USB or paired Wi-Fi. No cloud required.
ersinkoc/phonebox.zh: 將舊的 Android 手機變成可自訂的桌面面板與觸控控制台，支援 Windows、Linux 與 macOS。提供 124 個小工具與 30 個範本，涵蓋系統狀態、AI 程式設計、媒體與自動化，支援 13 種語言。可透過 USB 或已配對的 Wi-Fi 連線，無需雲端。

expo/exact.source: Write an app once. It runs natively on the web, macOS, iOS, and Linux, and an AI agent can build it, run it, see it, and test it on every one of them.
expo/exact.zh: 一次撰寫應用程式，即可原生執行於網頁、macOS、iOS 與 Linux，AI Agent 還能在各平台上建置、執行、觀看並測試。

firecrawl/firecrawl.source: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and 550+ data providers through one API.
firecrawl/firecrawl.zh: 為你的 Agent 打造更聰明的知識基礎設施。透過單一 API 進行搜尋、爬取，並存取 550 多個資料提供者。

google-labs-code/stitch-skills.source: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
google-labs-code/stitch-skills.zh: 一套設計用於搭配 Stitch MCP 伺服器的 Agent 技能函式庫。每項技能皆遵循 Agent Skills 開放標準，可相容於 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等程式設計代理。

govijr/terminal-mac.source: Entire MacOS running in your terminal.
govijr/terminal-mac.zh: 在你的終端機中執行完整的 macOS。

haydenschmitty/floorplan.source: See how your app actually fits together. An interactive, plain-English map of your codebase, drawn by Claude or Codex.
haydenschmitty/floorplan.zh: 看清你的應用程式實際如何組合在一起。這是由 Claude 或 Codex 繪製、以白話文呈現的互動式程式碼庫地圖。

heydamir/unslop.source: A Claude skill that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface
heydamir/unslop.zh: 一個 Claude 技能，可將看起來像 AI 生成的 vibe coding 介面，轉換為經過設計的介面。

heygen-com/hyperframes.source: AI video you can actually edit. HyperFrames is a free, open-source AI video editor. Describe any video and get a real project you can change down to the frame.
heygen-com/hyperframes.zh: 真正可編輯的 AI 影片。HyperFrames 是一款免費開源的 AI 影片編輯器。描述任何影片，即可取得可逐影格修改的真實專案。

huami1314/GestaltX.source: An MobileGestalt editor for iOS 27.x, featuring region-code tweaks, device presets, backups.
huami1314/GestaltX.zh: 適用於 iOS 27.x 的 MobileGestalt 編輯器，具備區域代碼調整、裝置預設集與備份功能。

interplains/Zero-Breach-Toolkit.source: Free, offline checks for known mercenary spyware on Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone and Android - plus the doors left open, suspicious links, emails, files and QR codes, your accounts, home network and nearby trackers. Apps with a window, 27 languages. Nothing leaves your computer.
interplains/Zero-Breach-Toolkit.zh: 免費、離線檢查 Windows、Mac、Linux、iPhone 與 Android 上已知的傭兵級間諜軟體，另外檢查遺留的開放門戶、可疑連結、電子郵件、檔案與 QR Code、你的帳號、家用網路及附近的追蹤器。附視窗應用程式，支援 27 種語言。資料不會離開你的電腦。

jacke-pp/open-yoki.source: An AI live-stream host that runs on one server: voice, face, chat, memory, posts. The base yoki runs on. By Jacke_pp · contact: DM @Jacke_pp on X
jacke-pp/open-yoki.zh: AI 直播主持人，執行於單一伺服器上：語音、臉部、聊天、記憶、貼文。是 yoki 所依賴的基礎。由 Jacke_pp 製作 · 聯絡方式：在 X 上私訊 @Jacke_pp

jamesondh/chimera-vocal-synth.source: the ultimate vocal synthesizer - sing, speak, beatbox, and more
jamesondh/chimera-vocal-synth.zh: 終極人聲合成器，能唱歌、說話、打節奏等等

jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm.source: Run your own Switch games natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: game code rewritten to ARM64, graphics direct to Metal, one app for the whole library. Bring your own games and keys. 把你自己的 Switch 游戏原生带到 iPhone / iPad / Mac。
jhaizhou-ops/S2Arm.zh: 在 iPhone、iPad 與 Mac 上原生執行你自己的 Switch 遊戲：遊戲程式碼重寫為 ARM64、圖形直接輸出至 Metal，一個應用程式涵蓋整個遊戲庫。自備遊戲與金鑰。

jingyaogong/minimind.source: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
jingyaogong/minimind.zh: 🧠 兩小時從零訓練出你自己的 64M LLM。

kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill.source: Local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Cut, captions, reframe, loudness, platform exports. No cloud, no API keys.
kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill.zh: 供程式碼代理使用的本地影片編輯器：42 個 FFmpeg 工具，具備機器可讀的契約與 MCP 伺服器，適用於 Claude Code、Cursor 與 Codex。支援剪輯、字幕、重新構圖、響度、各平台匯出。無需雲端，也無需 API 金鑰。

kevinraymond/florilegium.source: Procedurally generated Delft-blue page margins for LuaLaTeX, with plants, visitors, shells and Gothic tracery sampled from genomes, and a TikZ library that draws them in pure TikZ under pdfLaTeX.
kevinraymond/florilegium.zh: 為 LuaLaTeX 程序化生成的代爾夫特藍頁邊框，包含植物、訪客、貝殼及哥德式花飾，其花紋由基因組取樣而來；另附 TikZ 函式庫，可在 pdfLaTeX 下以純 TikZ 繪製。

krisgfx9/Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor.source: Show the battery level of wireless mice, headsets, keyboards and controllers on the Windows 10/11 taskbar. Lightweight tray app, no vendor software needed. Supports Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair, HyperX, Glorious, PS4/PS5 DualSense, Xbox and Bluetooth devices.
krisgfx9/Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor.zh: 在 Windows 10/11 工作列上顯示無線滑鼠、耳機、鍵盤與控制器的電量。輕量級系統匣應用程式，無需廠商軟體。支援 Logitech、Razer、SteelSeries、Corsair、HyperX、Glorious、PS4/PS5 DualSense、Xbox 及藍牙裝置。

lexifina/global-law.source: The world's law in git: any provision, any country, any date, and the law that wrote each word.
lexifina/global-law.zh: git 中的世界法律：任何條文、任何國家、任何日期，以及寫下每個字的法律。

libracoder/kiri.source: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative
libracoder/kiri.zh: 適用於 macOS、Windows 與 Linux 的小型快速容器執行環境，是免費的 Ngrok 替代方案。

man15h/tellyscope.source: Debloat your Android TV, install apps, browse and transfer files on it, all from your phone. no root, no PC.
man15h/tellyscope.zh: 精簡你的 Android TV、安裝應用程式、瀏覽與傳輸其中的檔案，全部可從手機操作。無需 root，也不需電腦。

mdiri-ai/SoduWork.source: The AI-native engine for teams and their agents. Multi-harness, multi-agent, self-hosted.
mdiri-ai/SoduWork.zh: 為團隊與其代理打造的 AI 原生引擎。支援多 harness、多代理，可自行架設。

meta/astryx.source: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
meta/astryx.zh: 一套完全可客製化且適合代理使用的開源設計系統。

milind-soni/OpenMausBot.source: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
milind-soni/OpenMausBot.zh: 開源的 Grok Bot 替代方案，內建供機器人使用的虛擬機。

mjmirza/app-store-compliance.source: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 117 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 95 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
mjmirza/app-store-compliance.zh: 避免常見的 App Store 與 Google Play 上架遭拒。提供開放的實戰手冊與送審前檢查工具，涵蓋 117 種已記錄的遭拒模式及修正方式、隱私清單與 Data safety 檢查、95 個追蹤中的期限（EU AI Act、DSA、COPPA、年齡相關法規），以及供 AI 程式碼代理使用的技能。

modelflare-ai/AnyModelBot.source: 🤖 Open-source, local-first alternative to Grok Bot, OpenAI dots and Claude Duet. Your own AI bots on any model: GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and 70+ more through one Modelflare key. Reach them in the app, WeChat or Feishu; they remember you, work in the background, run commands and use your computer. Pay per use.
modelflare-ai/AnyModelBot.zh: 🤖 開源、本地優先的 Grok Bot、OpenAI dots 與 Claude Duet 替代方案。可在任何模型上打造你自己的 AI 機器人：透過單一 Modelflare 金鑰使用 GPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok、DeepSeek、Kimi、GLM 等 70 多種模型。可在應用程式、微信或飛書中與其互動；它們會記住你、在背景工作、執行指令並使用你的電腦。按用量付費。

morganlinton/BeautifulRust.source: Agent Skills that teach coding agents to write, review, and port idiomatic Rust, plus a tested clippy config. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
morganlinton/BeautifulRust.zh: 教導程式碼代理撰寫、審查並移植慣用 Rust 程式的代理技能，附帶經過測試的 clippy 設定。支援 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、Cursor 與 Gemini CLI。

mromidev/claude-animated-shorts.source: Free Claude skill: viral animated story shorts (2D characters in a 3D world) with three.js + Remotion
mromidev/claude-animated-shorts.zh: 免費的 Claude 技能：以 three.js + Remotion 製作爆紅的動畫故事短片（3D 世界中的 2D 角色）。

mvanhorn/last30days-skill.source: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
mvanhorn/last30days-skill.zh: AI 代理技能，可跨 Reddit、X、YouTube、HN、Polymarket 與網路研究任何主題，然後綜合成有依據的摘要。

nginx/nginx.source: The official NGINX Open Source repository.
nginx/nginx.zh: NGINX 開源版的官方儲存庫。

obra/superpowers.source: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
obra/superpowers.zh: 一套真正有效的代理技能框架與軟體開發方法論。

oosexgang/hakios-xnu-kernel.source: Apple's open-source XNU kernel on Android phones: its own loader and drivers, Metal on the Adreno. Runs from RAM; a reboot gives the phone back to Android.
oosexgang/hakios-xnu-kernel.zh: 在 Android 手機上運行蘋果開源的 XNU 核心：自有載入器與驅動程式，Adreno 上的 Metal。從 RAM 執行；重新開機後手機即交還給 Android。

openvinotoolkit/openvino.source: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
openvinotoolkit/openvino.zh: OpenVINO™ 是一套開源工具包，用於最佳化與部署 AI 推論。

paipiange/nvzhuang.source: 1407 张 AI 女装参考图集与虚拟试穿网站，支持中英检索、OpenAI Images / Gemini / 豆包及自定义 Base URL、API Key、模型。https://github.com/paipiange/nvzhuang
paipiange/nvzhuang.zh: 1407 張 AI 女裝參考圖集與虛擬試穿網站，支援中英檢索、OpenAI Images / Gemini / 豆包及自訂 Base URL、API Key、模型。https://github.com/paipiange/nvzhuang

patch-gg/pixelfx.source: 244 pixel art effects, every one a small piece of code. Plus a Claude Code skill to make your own.
patch-gg/pixelfx.zh: 244 種像素藝術特效，每一種都是一小段程式碼。另附可用來製作自己特效的 Claude Code 技能。

pbakaus/impeccable.source: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
pbakaus/impeccable.zh: 程式碼代理的設計詞彙。以 polish 與 bolder 引導，以 critique 與 audit 審查，在 AI 粗製濫造的內容出貨前將其攔下。

physicsdolphin/nv-uefi-unlocker.source: UEFI pre-driver NVIDIA GPU unlocker for Windows Linux Hackintosh and all EFI-bootable system (Rust): SEC2 scrubber -> FWSEC/WPR2 -> signed Booter -> V67 four-write payload, read-back verified. Verified on most RTX 20 30 40 Series.
physicsdolphin/nv-uefi-unlocker.zh: UEFI 前置驅動程式 NVIDIA GPU 解鎖工具，適用於 Windows、Linux、Hackintosh 及所有可 EFI 開機的系統（Rust）：SEC2 清理 -> FWSEC/WPR2 -> 已簽章 Booter -> V67 四次寫入 payload，寫回後讀回驗證。已在多數 RTX 20、30、40 系列上驗證。

pingdotgg/t3code.source: The best way to control Claude Code, Codex and more from any computer or phone
pingdotgg/t3code.zh: 從任何電腦或手機控制 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的最佳方式。

pookjw/HermesEnabler.source: Enable Hermès Watch Faces on any Apple Watch devices
pookjw/HermesEnabler.zh: 在任何 Apple Watch 裝置上啟用 Hermès 錶面。

qybaihe/bla.source: 🛡️ BLA (bla-agents / Blind LLM Agents) — Open-source Blue Defense MCP server & CLI protecting JS/TS, Electron ASAR, WASM, Python, Native Binaries, SQLite, GGUF/Safetensors & Android DEX against AI reverse-engineering agents (REA).
qybaihe/bla.zh: 🛡️ BLA（bla-agents / Blind LLM Agents）— 開源藍色防禦 MCP 伺服器與 CLI，保護 JS/TS、Electron ASAR、WASM、Python、原生二進位檔、SQLite、GGUF/Safetensors 與 Android DEX，抵禦 AI 逆向工程代理（REA）。

rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner.source: 关掉国产安卓手机系统里的广告、热搜、资讯推荐和营销推送。不 root，可还原，支持 AI 智能体一键执行。
rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner.zh: 關掉國產安卓手機系統裡的廣告、熱搜、資訊推薦和行銷推播。不 root、可還原，支援 AI 智慧代理一鍵執行。

s1dashu/quiet-md.source: Blazing-fast native notes app and rich-text editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Built with Rust + GPUI. Local-first and beautifully designed.
s1dashu/quiet-md.zh: 為 macOS、Windows 與 Linux 打造的極速原生筆記應用程式與富文本編輯器。以 Rust + GPUI 建構。本地優先，設計精美。

sarpstar/cinecode.source: Films made with code. Short films, long YouTube videos, ads, explainers and music videos: an AI coding agent writes the script, builds every frame in code, designs the sound and hands you an MP4.
sarpstar/cinecode.zh: 以程式碼製作的影片。短片、長篇 YouTube 影片、廣告、解說與音樂錄影帶：AI 程式碼代理撰寫腳本、以程式碼建構每一幀、設計音效，最後交付 MP4。

shanselman/gputaskman.source: A GPU task manager for Windows, Linux, and WSL: per-process VRAM, GPU activity, and LLM model/KV-cache insights for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel GPUs (plus Huawei Ascend on Linux).
shanselman/gputaskman.zh: 適用於 Windows、Linux 與 WSL 的 GPU 工作管理員：逐程序 VRAM、GPU 活動，以及 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel GPU 的 LLM 模型與 KV 快取洞察（Linux 上另支援華為昇騰）。

sherlock-project/sherlock.source: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
sherlock-project/sherlock.zh: 依使用者名稱在各社群網路中搜尋社群媒體帳號。

shirai91/nx2android.source: A compatibility layer for porting Switch games to Android, one game at a time
shirai91/nx2android.zh: 一套相容層，逐一將 Switch 遊戲移植到 Android。

simplexai-labs/linger.source: Linger is An Open-Source Personal Agent That Runs Fully on Your PC.  We aim to break Big Tech’s grip on AI by bringing powerful local AI to everyday computers through efficient model–harness co-design, so everyone can run their own.
simplexai-labs/linger.zh: Linger 是一款開源個人代理，完全在你的電腦上執行。我們希望透過高效的模型與 harness 協同設計，把強大的本地 AI 帶到日常電腦上，打破大型科技公司對 AI 的掌控，讓每個人都能執行屬於自己的 AI。

sqlpxc/airhand.source: High-performance, low-latency remote desktop QUIC transport · hardware encoding and decoding · up to 120 fps Windows · macOS · Linux · Android · browser
sqlpxc/airhand.zh: 高效能、低延遲的遠端桌面 QUIC 傳輸協定 · 硬體編解碼 · 最高 120 fps · Windows · macOS · Linux · Android · 瀏覽器

storytold/craft-anything.source: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
storytold/craft-anything.zh: Craft Anything：理解任何軟體的運作方式，並打造屬於你自己的作品。

t3dotgg/tstack.source: The agent skills I use every day. Works with Claude Code and Codex.
t3dotgg/tstack.zh: 我每天都在用的 Agent Skills。支援 Claude Code 與 Codex。

thedotmack/claude-mem.source: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
thedotmack/claude-mem.zh: 為每個 Agent 提供跨工作階段的持久上下文。擷取 Agent 在工作階段中的所有操作，以 AI 壓縮後，將相關上下文注入後續工作階段。支援 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等更多工具。

toeverything/AFFiNE.source: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
toeverything/AFFiNE.zh: Notion 和 Miro 之外，還有更多選擇。AFFiNE（發音 [ə‘fain]）是新一代知識庫，將規劃、整理與創作整合在一起。以隱私為優先、開源、可自訂，開箱即用。

toyxyz/toyxyz_RGBMocap.source: Native Windows video motion capture with ExMR, FlowHMR and GVHMR, contact correction, humanoid retargeting, and FBX/VMD export.
toyxyz/toyxyz_RGBMocap.zh: 原生 Windows 影片動作擷取，支援 ExMR、FlowHMR 與 GVHMR，包含接觸修正、人形骨架重新定向，以及 FBX/VMD 匯出。

tradermonty/claude-trading-skills.source: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.
